description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #1, the create-a-new-user side of the same rule: svc{{PERMTESTID}} (ego.server.admin only, no ego.root) tries to create a brand-new user pre-loaded with ego.root. This is the same escalation as perm-85 by a different route -- instead of granting root to an existing account, hand it to a fresh one. CreateUserHandler must reject this exactly like UpdateUserHandler does.
